howTo: Type Cantonese in Jyutping, no tones needed: neihou for 你好. A whole phrase can go in one run, no spaces.

First, pick your characters on this page: Simplified, Hong Kong or Taiwan. Your code floats above the bar and the choices sit over the top row. Space types the first one, and a tap picks any. For more, press Shift, swipe up on the keys, or tap ⋯. Enter or a swipe turns the page. Next words follow each pick. Enter types the code as letters, and double Space types 。.

guide.line: Cantonese by its sounds, as Jyutping spells them.
points: Tones are optional. After a syllable, type v, x or q for tones 1, 2 or 3. Double the letter for tones 4, 5 or 6.
A whole phrase goes in one run, no spaces.
